verdict.rationale: Paxos documents converting stablecoins to USD and settling directly to a bank account (redeem, settle-to-bank, auto-convert-to-fiat), which covers the core off-ramp-to-bank-transfer mechanic, but all evidence is USD/wire-transfer specific with no published list of supported fiat currencies or countries for payouts. missing for 10: published multi-currency/country coverage list, evidence of non-USD bank rails, independent confirmation of international payout reach.
